paragraphs.source_en: Guided by Gohei, Sakuzaemon entered a house on the bank of the Seta River. “Hurry and ready a boat for Fushimi.” After curtly issuing the order, he hurriedly changed his clothes. paragraphs.source_en: Although Mitsunari had repeatedly insisted that the Maeda brothers were of no consequence, Sakuzaemon did not agree.
